description: What whales are doing, per coin. view: summary (default with a coin: net flow over 1h/4h/24h/7d, exchange vs on-chain vs Hyperliquid split, flow against price), hourly (buy and sell dollars per hour), trades (individual whale trades, newest first), venues (which exchanges hold the flow), context (is this unusual for THIS coin, accepts a list), hyperliquid (fills with both wallets named), onchain (DEX swaps on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum with the signer).

breakdown.description: hourly only: split each hour by exchange or wallet (Pro).

chain.description: ethereum, base or arbitrum. Omit for all.

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

coins.description: Several coins in one call (list or "BTC,ETH"), up to 10.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

hours.description: How many hours back to read.

limit.description: Rows to return (usually up to 200; more is clamped and said).

since_ms.description: Only rows newer than this Unix-ms time (polling cursor).

source.description: trades only: exchanges, DEX swaps or both.

name: whale_activity

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

title: Whale activity on a coin
